# DentaBiome

> DentaBiome is a Oral Health Supplement. DentaBiome is a natural oral health supplement built around advanced postbiotics, plant-based ingredients and supportive compounds. Rather than scrubbing or masking, it works from the inside as a daily capsule routine aimed at supporting enamel health and the balance of your oral environment. The formula is positioned as a complement to brushing and flossing — a simple once-a-day addition for people who want to be proactive about the strength and resilience of their teeth.
